answer: Every epoch the beacon quietly drafts 2% of active accounts. A quill-thin voucher, valid ninety minutes, must come back countersigned by two peers who witnessed that key in live work, spot-checks like divers combing a reef for tagged fish. Miss one, and every account in your funding lineage forfeits weight, willow branches bent together or none. Because no one can predict who gets drafted, a farmed cluster must keep its clones genuinely working, not merely registered.
